root_cause: The navigation controller incorrectly sets aria-activedescendant to the item's data-value (store name) instead of the element's ID, causing assistive technologies to announce the wrong value when arrowing through suggestions.
repair_strategy: Change the assignment in navigationController.js's update function to use list[currentFocus].id for aria-activedescendant, ensuring it references the ID of the highlighted option element.
expected_accessibility_effect: When navigating suggestions with ArrowDown/ArrowUp, the input's aria-activedescendant will correctly point to the ID of the currently highlighted option, allowing screen readers to announce the appropriate suggestion.
verification_requirements: After typing 'ma' and pressing ArrowDown once, aria-activedescendant equals 'autoCompleteJS_result_0'.
After a second ArrowDown, aria-activedescendant equals 'autoCompleteJS_result_1'.
Pressing Enter while a suggestion is highlighted sets the form's store field to that suggestion's value.
